event: Other spec text says the same thing: irrelevant, not to be read. It gives no value.

I submitted a verdict of **verified**: the repository has no specification text that says what DIGEST_8..15 read back in SHA-256 mode.

The only other place the question comes up is the register description in `hw/ip/hmac/data/hmac.hjson`, line 503. It says `{DIGEST8 - DIGEST15} are irrelevant and should not be read out.` The generated `hw/ip/hmac/doc/registers.md` repeats this at lines 422–423. That wording tells software not to read those registers, but it doesn't give a value. It also doesn't say whether the values differ after an earlier SHA-384/512 operation.

I only searched the `hw/ip/hmac` markdown and hjson files, and I did not look at the RTL or tests.
